summary: Iter-7 testing complete for the new AI Co-Pilot feature. Backend: 117/117 pytest tests PASS (108 prior + 9 new TestCoPilot). Frontend: all UI flows for CoPilotWidget pass (launcher visibility, panel open, greeting, 5 quick actions, typing indicator, assistant response from Claude, custom send + input-clear, NEW/clear, close/X, and full session persistence across page reload). The Co-Pilot's snapshot grounding is working end-to-end — Claude's reply referenced live account balance ($5,000 paper), recent signals (5x HOLD across BTCUSD/XAUUSD), open trades (0), and active triggers (1 BTCUSD 5% drop alert) verbatim from the snapshot.

minor.issue: If the upstream Claude call fails, the route raises HTTPException(502) with the raw exception message in detail. Consider sanitising/wrapping the message so internal stack info / API keys can't leak. Currently low-risk because emergentintegrations exceptions are generic, but worth tightening.
Pre-existing 7 PytestRemovedIn10Warning on class-scoped instance-method fixtures (no new ones introduced by iter-7).

issues: When the panel is open on dashboard, it overlaps the right side of the main content (chart area is partially hidden behind the panel at md:right-6). This is by design (floating panel), but a subtle backdrop dim or an option to undock would improve UX. Low priority.

action_items: (LOW) Sanitise 502 error detail in /api/copilot/chat to avoid leaking upstream exception text.
(LOW) Consider rate-limiting /api/copilot/chat per user (currently unlimited — could be abused to burn Emergent LLM credits).
critical_code_review_comments: copilot.py is a clean 219-line module — single responsibility, async I/O throughout, MongoDB ObjectId properly excluded by projecting only named fields into the returned snapshot. No _id leakage in any response.

Session id is generated via uuid.uuid4().hex (32-char) and stored in db.copilot_sessions with composite key (user_id, session_id) — correct multi-tenant isolation; a user cannot fetch another user's session because every find() includes user_id.
/api/copilot/sessions/{session_id} returns 404 when not found OR when owned by another user (because user_id filter is applied) — correct (no information leak via 403 vs 404).

LlmChat session continuity: copilot.py relies on emergentintegrations LlmChat to persist history server-side keyed by session_id, AND keeps an independent message log in db.copilot_sessions for UI display. Verified working: 2nd chat call with same session_id returns same id and yields a coherent multi-turn answer (snapshot freshly rebuilt each turn — no stale cache).

Frontend CoPilotWidget.jsx (253 lines): correctly uses process.env via the shared `api` axios instance, localStorage for session_id, useRef to avoid stale closure issues. Auto-scroll, disabled-state on busy, error toast (copilot-error), and Enter-to-send all implemented properly. data-testid coverage is comprehensive.

Quick-action testid is built from `q.slice(0,18).replace(/\s+/g, '-')` — works but slightly fragile if QUICK_ACTIONS strings change. Consider using an index suffix (copilot-quick-0..4) for more stable selectors. Not blocking.

The launcher is at `fixed bottom-24 right-6 z-40` — confirmed visually clear of the 'Made with Emergent' badge at bottom-right. Panel z-50 sits above launcher z-40, so when open the launcher is correctly hidden.

Snapshot keys (bot_config, accounts, recent_signals, open_trades, recent_trades, panic, active_triggers) match the contract from the review request exactly. bot_config is conditionally absent if the user has none — acceptable; UI doesn't depend on it being present.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is read via os.environ['...'] (KeyError if missing). Consider .get with a clear startup check so the error is surfaced at boot, not on first chat request. Minor.
